notes.title: Rollback
notes.content:
Hello,

We’d like to inform you that the final review process for the game is taking longer than expected. Additionally, due to unavoidable circumstances, we will temporarily roll the game back to the 2022 version.

In a previous announcement, we mentioned that a rollback would not be necessary. However, after further discussions with the Steam support team, we’ve come to the conclusion that a rollback to the earlier version is unfortunately unavoidable.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may cause to those who have purchased the game. We’ll do our best to restore everything as quickly as possible.

For more details on the rollback and its reasons, please refer to the previous announcement:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1924140/view/515206275424846517?l=english

As previously mentioned, additional updates and DLC content are currently in development. We’ll share any new information as soon as it's available.

Thank you, as always, for your interest in our game.
Wishing you a great day ahead.

Thank you.

notes.title: Now I can finally catch my breath.
notes.content:
We just heard back from Steam.
It was actually a reply to the message we sent two days ago, so their response came a bit late.

They told me to keep the game as normal for the time being.

In other words, it looks like we won’t need to re-roll the game.
The announcement we posted earlier has been rolled back.
If their reply had come just 3 or 4 hours earlier, this whole mix-up could’ve been avoided…
(I really didn’t have a choice — there were just seven hours left before the deadline they gave us.)

Still, I feel a bit relieved now.
It really hurt to feel like we were taking the game away from our players.

That said, the sales suspension of our game is likely to continue for a while.

Please hang in there until the free DLC is released.

Thank you all so much for your interest and support.

Wishing you a great day!

notes.title: We sincerely apologize.
notes.content:
Hello,
First and foremost, we sincerely apologize.

At the request of Steam, our game has been rolled back to the 2022 alpha version.
Upon launching the game, you may see a crude UI and unfinished content.
We are truly sorry for this inconvenience.

[h2]Estimated Recovery Time[/h2]
It will take approximately 3 weeks to 1 month to restore the game to its intended state.
We sincerely apologize to all existing players for the disruption.

Below is a detailed explanation regarding this matter.
A four-line summary is also provided at the bottom.

[h2]Reason for Rollback[/h2]
Steam has informed us that the current version of the game
"includes explicit content that was not present during the 2022 review."
They stated that such characters (or elements) must be distributed
as a separate DLC.

Accordingly, Steam presented us with two options:

Roll the game back to the 2022 version.

If not, face the potential termination of business relations.

As a result, our game has been temporarily delisted,
and in the worst-case scenario, we could be permanently removed from Steam.
To prevent such an outcome, we had no choice but to proceed with the rollback.

[h2]Future Measures[/h2]
We plan to re-release the current content in the form of a DLC.
According to Steam’s policies, DLCs require a minimum of two weeks of review time.
We estimate that the full recovery process will take 3 weeks to 1 month.

During this period, existing purchasers may experience the game in an incomplete state.
We once again sincerely apologize for this.

[h2]Clarification on Misunderstandings[/h2]
This rollback has nothing to do with the following:

Use of AI-generated content

Censorship issues

Steam has clearly stated that
this action was due to a policy and review process violation, not content-related issues.
We kindly ask for your understanding.

[h2]Summary[/h2]

The game has been rolled back to the 2022 alpha version.

This is not due to AI or censorship concerns,
but rather a violation of Steam’s system policies.

The content will be re-released as a DLC, (DLC is free)
and the game is expected to return to normal within 3 to 4 weeks.

We sincerely apologize for the confusion.
We are working hard to resolve this issue as soon as possible.
Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Next step!
notes.content:
We are currently modifying the game to meet Steam's requirements.

For users
You won't notice any major gameplay changes, 
we've made a lot of systemic changes.

In addition
Rewards for Explorer Stages 2 and 3 have been temporarily removed.

Those two stages were rewarded with AI images.
We've been thinking about what to do with that for a while.

We decided to take the plunge and remove them and replace them with new illustrations.
Steam hasn't pointed out any AI-related issues, but it's been a bit of an annoyance.

This will take a month or two.

And around the time of the update, we'll be releasing a new costume DLC. 
Each new outfit will be accompanied by an additional dead scene.

notes.title: Buy it now before that happens!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42438104/e567767573c130ea0a100cc6fcc4a4764688a592.png[/img]

!!!Urgent Announcement Regarding Steam!!!

Steam has suddenly contacted us with an unexpected request!

Steam has demanded that we revert our game to the version submitted before its release in 2022. They are instructing us to roll back everything to the previous version, citing differences between the current state and the version we initially submitted a year before release.

Shockingly, Steam has not even provided a one-week grace period! They have informed us that we must complete this rollback by March 28. Additionally, they sent this notification right before the weekend, leaving us unable to communicate with them until next week.

We find it incomprehensible that, after three years without any prior communication on this issue, they would abruptly issue such a notice. Moreover, Steam has not specified exactly what needs to be fixed or changed and is simply demanding a full rollback.

To those planning to purchase our game, please hurry!
After March 28, you may no longer be able to purchase it!

To our existing customers, please trust us!
We will take all possible measures to ensure that our current users do not suffer any inconvenience.

For your reference, we were in the midst of preparing a free H-scene update and a paid costume pack!
If our game manages to survive this situation, we promise to return with good news soon!

notes.title: DELAY (feat. covid-19)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42438104/0988c4832151e87163198949b837279f3dde543e.png[/img]

COVID-19 has spread in our office.
In my case, I was inevitably hospitalized because of a chronic disease.
I was discharged from the hospital after a few days of quarantine, but my condition is still not returning due to COVID-19.
This inevitably pushed back the previously promised release date.
We are sorry to announce this to those who are waiting for the game to be released.

[h1]The new release date is March 17.[/h1]


Ps. Many people ask me about my health.  For those people, I'd like to briefly talk about my physical condition. 
Since I got sick three years ago, making ISEKAI QUEST, I've still been in bad shape. I can't eat most of the food, and I go out about three times a year. I was 181cm tall and 55kg right before I got COVID-19.
So I'm literally putting all my energy into making games. I feel like I'm getting better little by little, but I can say that normal life is impossible.



Once again, I'm sorry for the delay in the release of the game. We'll come back with the best game possible.

notes.content:
